help.title: EvernightIndex builds a SQLite index of one directory tree and answers queries about it.
help.exit.3: 3  partial failure or pending log export
help.more: Run "evernightindex <command> --help" for command options; README.md describes behavior, limits and platform status.
help.notImplementedNote: Commands marked "not implemented" parse and validate their options, then refuse to run: nothing is scanned and no database is created.
cmd.index.summary: Create or update the index of one directory
cmd.find.summary: Query indexed entries by name, path or typed filter
cmd.dupes.summary: Compare two indexed directories for duplicate regular files
cmd.info.summary: Show bound root, format version, run status and digest coverage
cmd.export-log.summary: Export pending change-log events of one run
cmd.recover.summary: Retry publishing a finished temporary working copy
flag.help.desc: Show help for the program or for the given command
flag.lang.desc: Message language; auto follows the environment
flag.verbose.desc: Print one line for every processed path and operation
flag.quiet.desc: Disable regular progress output; errors are still shown
flag.log-dir.desc: Directory for change-log CSV files; index needs --change-log, export-log accepts it directly
flag.temp-dir.desc: Parent directory for a temporary working copy of the database
flag.sha256.desc: Compute and store SHA256 digests of regular files
flag.deep.desc: Recompute and store SHA256 for every regular file; requires --sha256=true
flag.change-log.desc: Record change events for CSV export
flag.exclude.desc: Exclusion pattern relative to the scan root; supports *, ?, [...], ** and a trailing / for directories only; repeatable
flag.one-file-system.desc: Do not descend into other mounted file systems
flag.workers.desc: Concurrent content readers; 0 selects the automatic bounded value
flag.lock-timeout.desc: How long to wait for the formal database lock; 0 fails immediately
flag.read-retries.desc: How many times a file changed while hashing is read again
flag.name.desc: Match the entry name with a wildcard pattern
flag.path.desc: Match the relative path with a wildcard pattern
flag.filter.desc: Typed filter expression such as size>1024 or type=file
flag.case.desc: Name comparison policy; auto uses the case policy recorded in the database
flag.details.desc: Print detailed records instead of paths only
flag.sort.desc: Sort field and direction, for example size:desc
flag.limit.desc: Maximum number of results; 0 means unlimited
flag.offset.desc: Number of results to skip for paging
flag.verify.desc: On-demand re-check of indexed paths; a value is mandatory
flag.run.desc: Run ID used for change-log export or recovery
err.flagNotApplicable: Option {flag} does not apply to command "{command}"
err.invalidBool: Invalid boolean value "{value}" for {flag}; allowed values: true, false
err.invalidDuration: Invalid duration "{value}" for {flag}; use a duration such as 30s, 2m or 0
err.shortFlagForm: Unsupported option form "{flag}": write short options separately (-v -q) and pass values separately (-d <path>) or as -d=<path>
err.conflictDeepNoSha256: --deep recomputes and stores SHA256, so it cannot be combined with --sha256=false
err.conflictVerifyNeedsMatch: --verify=sha256 reads current file content and requires --match=sha256; the mode is never switched implicitly
err.conflictNullDetails: --null writes paths only and cannot be combined with --details
err.conflictLogDirNeedsChangeLog: --log-dir only takes effect together with --change-log on the index command
err.workersRange: --workers must be between 0 and {max} (0 = automatic); got {value}
err.notImplemented: Command "{command}" is not implemented in this build; nothing was scanned or written
err.databaseTooNew: Database format version {found} is newer than the supported version {supported}: {path}
err.databaseVersion: Database format version {found} is not supported (supported: {supported}): {path}
err.flagBeforeCommand: Option {flag} belongs to a command; give it after the command name
err.databaseLocked: Could not acquire the write lock for {path} within {timeout}; it is held by {owner}. Wait for the other run to finish or raise --lock-timeout.
err.databaseUnknownSchema: Database schema is incomplete or unrecognized (missing {missing}): {path}; it will not be rebuilt automatically.
err.rootMismatch: The database is bound to root {expected}, but {found} was requested; the binding is never changed automatically.
err.indexIncomplete: {path} has no published generation yet, so it is not a complete index.
err.publishConflict: The published generation is {found} but this run started at {expected}; publishing was refused instead of overwriting another result.
err.exportPending: Index published, but {count} change-log events are still pending export.
err.scanIO: Failed to read file system metadata: {path} ({reason})
stats.progress: discovered {discovered}, processed {processed} (succeeded {succeeded}, failed {failed}), files {files}, dirs {dirs}, hashes {hashes} (failed {hash_failed}), error events {errors}, published {published}, read {bytes} bytes, elapsed {elapsed}
stats.summary: Finished: processed {processed}, succeeded {succeeded}, failed {failed}, files {files}, dirs {dirs}, hashes {hashes} (failed {hash_failed}), error events {errors}, published {published}, read {bytes} bytes, elapsed {elapsed}
stats.interrupted: Interrupted: processed {processed}, succeeded {succeeded}, failed {failed}, files {files}, dirs {dirs}, hashes {hashes} (failed {hash_failed}), error events {errors}, published {published}, read {bytes} bytes, elapsed {elapsed}; unpublished work was discarded and the previous index is unchanged
stats.failed: Failed: processed {processed}, succeeded {succeeded}, failed {failed}, files {files}, dirs {dirs}, hashes {hashes} (failed {hash_failed}), error events {errors}, published {published}, read {bytes} bytes, elapsed {elapsed}; the previous index is unchanged
report.published: Published generation {generation} from run {run} with {entries} entries
report.cancelAfterCommit: Interrupt arrived after the commit; generation {generation} stays published and is not reported as rolled back
report.aborted: Publish failed and rolled back; the previous generation stays usable
report.abortedSummary: Publish aborted: processed {processed}, succeeded {succeeded}, failed {failed}, error events {errors}, published {published}, elapsed {elapsed}
report.partial: Partial result: some areas could not be covered ({gaps})
report.interrupted: The run was interrupted before publishing
report.abandoned: The process ended without finishing this run
report.planCreateSha256: Creating an index: root {root}, database {database}; SHA256 enabled (regular file content will be read), workers {workers}, retries {read_retries}
report.planCreateNoSha256: Creating an index: root {root}, database {database}; SHA256 disabled (no file content will be read)
report.planUpdateSha256: Updating the index: root {root}, database {database}, generation {generation} to {next}; quick mode with SHA256 (content is read only for new, changed or unverifiable files), workers {workers}, retries {read_retries}
report.planUpdateNoSha256: Updating the index: root {root}, database {database}, generation {generation} to {next}; quick mode without SHA256 (no file content will be read, and changed files lose their stored digest)
report.planUpdateDeep: Updating the index: root {root}, database {database}, generation {generation} to {next}; deep mode (every readable regular file is read again and its SHA256 is stored), workers {workers}, retries {read_retries}
report.reusingIncomplete: Database {path} has no published generation yet; this run builds the first published index instead of updating one
report.changeSummary: Changes: added {added}, updated {updated}, removed {removed}, excluded {excluded}, unverified {unverified}, unchanged {unchanged}
report.hashReused: {count} files kept their stored SHA256 without reading the content; that is a quick-mode match, not a fresh content verification
report.unverifiedKept: {count} previously indexed entries were kept and marked unverified because their area was not fully covered this run
report.quickModeCaveat: Quick mode compares type, size, modification time, file identity and change time only; a content change that leaves all of them unchanged is not detected. Use --deep to recompute every digest.
scan.root.invalid: scan root is no longer valid: {path} ({reason})
err.changeLogNotImplemented: Change logs (--change-log) are not implemented yet; this run will not silently ignore the option. Remove it and run again
err.tempDirNotImplemented: Temporary working copies (--temp-dir) are not implemented yet; this run will not silently ignore the option. Remove it and run again
